/movie/mKs_ldkrguoyzk37dgulwm5d3d7ct4.storyline: Based on the Bongo-dong battle in 1920, which remained a great victory within the Korean independence battles. During the operation Hae-chul is reunited with Jang-ha (RYU Jun-yeol), a young squad commander, whose mission is to defend Samdunja.
